announcements.title: Kangentic Mobile is live on iOS and Android
announcements.body: Check on your agents, answer their prompts, and review diffs from your phone. Scan a code below with your phone's camera to open its store listing.

sections.heading: After installing: pair your desktop
sections.body: Turn on **Mobile bridge** in Settings > Mobile Devices, click **Pair a device**, and scan the code it shows with the app.
